prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Companion's Personality", "Select Trait"]
1: ["Find Your Existing Pets", "Enter your account email to locate previously saved desktop companions before logging in.", "Cloud Pet Lookup", "Search Account"]
2: ["Calibrating Desktop Bounds", "Testing screen overlay rendering areas so your pet lands safely on your desktop."]
3: ["Welcome to Your Desktop!", "Your pet is officially ready to explore your screen.", "Release Pet to Desktop", "Click to launch your new companion onto your screen now!", "Release Pet Now"]
4: ["Pick Your Pet Journey", "Choose Express Adoption (1 min) or Custom Creation (3 mins) to start.", "You can always create more pets later from your desktop tray."]
5: ["Screen taking too long? Click refresh or sign in as guest to restore your pet later."]
6: ["Upload High Quality Pet Photos", "Ensure well-lit, front-facing photos for best 3D pet generation results.", "Supported formats: JPG, PNG under 10MB.", "Lighting Check Passed"]
7: ["Look for the pet icon in your system tray (bottom right) to manage pet visibility anytime."]
8: ["Your Pet Arrived with a Gift!", "You unlocked the Free Starter Toy Pack! Find it in your desktop pet menu.", "Unlocked: Plush Toy"]
9: ["Choose Express or Custom Pet", "Compare path features side-by-side and dive right in."]

verdicts.problem: Suggests bypassing or getting around the required sign-in step.
